author: worthitnow
quote:
I don't know what this nonsense is but it's not GTA, the main characters of Lucia and Jason are particularly unlikable, Lucia is a petulant self centered spoiled brat, and Jason is just a lifeless husk. The larger than life characterisation of past games is nowhere to be seen. I simply did not care what happened to either of them, pretty much from the outset.

The first half of the game is just boring, performing chores is not gaming, I perform chores in real life, who on earth thought this was a good idea, it feels like padding, and on a game that took, 13 years to make and $1b, thats unforgivable.

The game fails to fix some of GTA's biggest flaws, mission structure is the same old story, speak to an NPC drive a bit, it all goes wrong shoot your way out. they had the time and budget to break the mould but didn't.

The satire of all sides of the political spectrum is also gone, the game takes a decidedly sympathetic view of the left, which should be no surprise to anyone, given the woke DEI driven culture of western game studios. The biting commentary is just MIA the game failed to make me laugh the way previous games have, it's just very sanitised and millennial coded.

Performance is abysmal, I mean utterly ridiculous in 2026. the game stutters along at 20-30 fps, and when in combat it can get to slideshow type frame rates, I had to turn off due to nausea on multiple occasions. It's also buggy as hell, and some of these bugs are in the first few hours, after 13 years of development, it's odd to say the least that bugs in the first half of the game are so prevalent, what were the play testers doing for 13 years.

Overall, it's not GTA, but some kind of weird life sim, the main characters are utterly forgettable, and although the world is full it feels strangely lifeless, there is no real character to the world, its just there. Missions are same old same old. the story is often nonsensical, and the quality of writing is a definite downgrade from GTA V, the world is sanitised within an inch of it's life, the game takes no risks whatsoever. Performance is just ridiculous, often unplayable, what a waste of £80, I will never trust Rockstar again after this mess.
